# Premio Peptides

> Premio Peptides is a UK-based supplier of research-grade peptides, serving universities, pharmaceutical companies, biotechnology firms, contract research organisations, and government laboratories. All compounds are verified to 98%+ purity via independent third-party HPLC analysis and supplied strictly for in vitro laboratory research.

Premio Peptides operates under BELL RED LIMITED (Company No. 12841067), registered in England and Wales, incorporated 27 August 2020. The company specialises in pre-formulated peptide research stacks delivered in preloaded injection pens — requiring no reconstitution — with temperature-controlled same-day dispatch across the United Kingdom.

What distinguishes Premio Peptides in the UK research peptides market is the focus on precision-formulated multi-peptide stacks rather than individual compounds. Each product ships with a batch-specific Certificate of Analysis including HPLC chromatogram, mass spectrometry confirmation, and ISO-accredited laboratory details. The company maintains rigorous research verification protocols: all orders are reviewed, and buyers must confirm a lawful research purpose before dispatch.

Premio Peptides serves researchers across weight management, regenerative medicine, and injury recovery disciplines. The product range includes triple-receptor agonist compounds (GLP-1/GIP/glucagon), copper peptide regeneration blends, and recovery peptide stacks. All products are preloaded pens with 99%+ purity, free UK delivery, and CoA included.

## Products

- [Retatrutide 40mg Pen](https://premiopeptides.co.uk/compounds/retatrutide): Triple-receptor (GLP-1, GIP, glucagon) weight management research compound. Preloaded 40mg pen, once-weekly subcutaneous injection. Currently in Phase 3 clinical trials.
- [GHK-Cu Glow Stack](https://premiopeptides.co.uk/compounds/ghk-cu-glow-stack): Copper peptide + BPC-157 + TB-500 regeneration blend. 2x 35mg preloaded pens for skin elasticity, collagen production, and recovery research.
- [BPC-157 & TB-500 Wolverine Stack](https://premiopeptides.co.uk/compounds/bpc-157-tb-500-wolverine): Recovery blend for accelerated muscle, ligament, and tendon healing research. 40mg preloaded pen.
